==Description==
The '''Sniper''' is a narrator that appears in [[Story Mode|Story]] mode.

He is the [[Sniper]] tower as a narrator.

==Appearance== 
{{Tabber
|Current
|The '''Sniper''' takes the appearance of the Level 0 default [[Sniper]] tower. He has tan skin, a green camo shirt and pants, a green cap, green knee-pad and buckles.

The '''Sniper''' carries a Remington 700 in all of its animations.

|Version 1
|The '''Sniper''' takes the appearance of the Level 0 default [[Sniper]] tower. He has tan skin, a green camo shirt and pants, a green cap, green knee-pad and buckles.

However, unlike the regular [[Sniper]], it has destroyed clothes, which includes torn left sleeve, missing buckle and a broken cap. Dirt can also be seen on its face and the left knee-pad normally seen on that upgrade is missing.

The '''Sniper''' carries a Remington 700 in all of its animations.
}}
